title: Targeted Regulation of AhGRF3b by ahy-miR396 Modulates Leaf Growth and Cold Tolerance in Peanut.
authors: Zhang, Xin; Liu, Qimei; Liu, Xinyu; Lin, Haoyu; Zhang, Xiaoyu; Zhang, Rui; Chen, Zhenbo; Zhang, Xiaoji; Tian, Yuexia; Xue, Yunyun; Zhang, Huiqi; Li, Na; Nie, Pingping; Bai, Dongmei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究花生miR396靶向AhGRF3b调控叶片生长与耐冷性，涉及转录因子功能与蛋白互作，但核心为湿实验与表型分析，无AI或物理模拟方法，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Peanut (Arachis hypogaea L.) is an important oil and cash crop, but its growth and productivity are severely constrained by low-temperature stress. Growth-regulating factors (GRFs) are plant-specific transcription factors involved in development and stress responses, yet their roles in peanut remain poorly understood. In this study, we identified AhGRF3b as a direct target of ahy-miR396 using degradome sequencing, which demonstrated precise miRNA-mediated cleavage sites within the AhGRF3b transcript. Expression profiling confirmed that ahy-miR396 suppresses AhGRF3b via post-transcriptional cleavage rather than translational repression. Functional analyses showed that overexpression of AhGRF3b in Arabidopsis thaliana promoted leaf expansion by enhancing cell proliferation. Specifically, leaf length, width, and petiole length increased by 104%, 22%, and 28%, respectively (p < 0.05). Under cold stress (0  degrees C for 7 days), transgenic lines (OE-2 and OE-6) exhibited significantly better growth than Col-0, with fresh weight increased by 158% and 146%, respectively (p < 0.05). Effect size analysis further confirmed these differences (Cohen's d = 11.6 for OE-2 vs. Col-0; d = 6.3 for OE-6 vs. Col-0). Protein-protein interaction assays, performed using the yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) system and 3D protein-protein docking models, further supported that AhGRF3b interacts with Catalase 1 (AhCAT1), vacuolar cation/proton exchanger 3 (AhCAX3), probable polyamine oxidase 4 (AhPAO4), and ACT domain-containing protein 11 (AhACR11), which are involved in reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging and ion homeostasis. These interactions were associated with enhanced CAT and PAO enzymatic activities, reduced ROS accumulation, and upregulation of stress-related genes under cold stress. These findings suggest that the ahy-miR396/AhGRF3b module plays a potential regulatory role in leaf morphogenesis and cold tolerance, providing valuable genetic resources for breeding cold-tolerant peanut varieties.
abstract_zh: 花生（Arachis hypogaea L.）是一种重要的油料和经济作物，但其生长和生产力受到低温胁迫的严重制约。生长调节因子（GRFs）是植物特有的转录因子，参与发育和胁迫响应，然而它们在花生中的作用仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们通过降解组测序（degradome sequencing）鉴定出AhGRF3b是ahy-miR396的直接靶标，该测序方法精确展示了AhGRF3b转录本内的miRNA介导的切割位点。表达谱分析证实，ahy-miR396通过转录后切割而非翻译抑制来抑制AhGRF3b。功能分析表明，在拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中过表达AhGRF3b通过增强细胞增殖促进了叶片扩展。具体而言，叶长、叶宽和叶柄长度分别增加了104%、22%和28%（p < 0.05）。在冷胁迫（0摄氏度持续7天）下，转基因株系（OE-2和OE-6）表现出显著优于Col-0的生长，鲜重分别增加了158%和146%（p < 0.05）。效应量分析进一步证实了这些差异（OE-2与Col-0相比，Cohen's d = 11.6；OE-6与Col-0相比，d = 6.3）。通过酵母双杂交（Y2H）系统和三维蛋白质-蛋白质对接模型进行的蛋白质相互作用分析进一步支持AhGRF3b与过氧化氢酶1（AhCAT1）、液泡阳离子/质子交换体3（AhCAX3）、可能的多胺氧化酶4（AhPAO4）和含ACT结构域蛋白11（AhACR11）相互作用，这些蛋白参与活性氧（ROS）清除和离子稳态。这些相互作用与冷胁迫下CAT和PAO酶活性的增强、ROS积累的减少以及胁迫相关基因的上调相关。这些发现表明，ahy-miR396/AhGRF3b模块在叶片形态建成和耐冷性中发挥潜在调控作用，为培育耐冷花生品种提供了宝贵的遗传资源。
